title: Sister Maria's flame in the convent cell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Sister Maria's flame in the convent cell, about late 1800s at Catholic convent, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in the late 1800s while sleeping in her small cell in a Catholic Convent a young nun named sister Maria was awakened by a shining object like a flame that appeared to emerge from her room's wall and hover above her

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a young nun, Sister Maria, who in the late 1800s was sleeping in her small cell in a Catholic convent. He says she was woken by a shining object like a flame that seemed to come out of the wall and hover above her, a story he tells in an episode about how religious visions and UFO encounters might be linked.
